aiFlow.introMessage:
We currently offer AI-assisted enquiries for weddings only. For prices, answers or contact about another type of event, please reach us through the website or at mail@engestofte.dk.

I am an AI assistant, not a person. Your messages are stored in Engestofte Estate’s enquiry history. Do not share sensitive personal information. This is a prototype and is not approved for production use under GDPR.
aiFlow.draftResumeNotice: Your draft is saved in this browser. You can return and continue later. This is a prototype: local storage of personal data has not been approved for GDPR compliant production use.
aiFlow.draftUnreadableNotice: A draft from another version was found but cannot be opened. It has been preserved. Start over only if you want to delete it.
aiFlow.draftCompleteNotice: Your completed enquiry is saved locally. Continue by logging in or creating an account below.
aiFlow.confirmNewDraft: Starting a new enquiry will delete this draft from the browser. Continue?
aiFlow.draftStorageNotice: Your draft is saved locally and is not sent to Engestofte as a request until you log in or create an account.
stepQuestions: What name should the enquiry be created under?

Hi, {name} 😃

When are you planning to hold your wedding?
How many guests do you expect? Should accommodation at Engestofte Gods be booked for all guests for the entire period?

That covers the essentials! 😊

Choose the direction that best suits your wedding. For example, reply “Option 1”. You can change your choice later.

What would you like for food and drinks? Are there any allergies or dietary needs we should know about? Do you have any optional extras, practical wishes or a budget in mind? Those details are optional.

aiFlow.error: We could not get a response right now. Please try again.
aiFlow.finalMessage:
Thank you, {name}!

We have all the information and are taking you to the next step 😊

weddingDirectionOptions.title: Option 1 · Standard wedding
weddingDirectionOptions.description: The basic package with welcome drink, three-course dinner with wine menu, coffee and sweets, soft bar, coordination, a nine-hour celebration and bridal-suite stay.

weddingDirectionOptions.title: Option 2 · Intimate wedding
weddingDirectionOptions.description: The standard wedding combined with a reception in the Workshop, including tapas, coffee/tea, beer, water and crémant.

weddingDirectionOptions.title: Option 3 · Tailored wedding
weddingDirectionOptions.description: A combination of the elements that suit you. Engestofte can help plan the day and Johan can clarify the details with you.
